youtube.title: Where Did Your Raise Go? Lifestyle Creep, Shown Month by Month
youtube.description:
A raise of eight hundred a month. By December, nothing left. An invented story, month by month.

Nora gets a raise and promises to save half. Then come the dinners, the new phone, the better flat. Nothing she buys is foolish. The film names the pattern researchers call lifestyle creep and shows how ordinary each step feels. It is a story, not advice, and the effect is not the same for every household.
